title: gastrochilus hoyopsis
intro: Gastrochilus hoyopsis, commonly known as the Hoy's Ghost Orchid, is a rare and endangered orchid species native to the Himalayas. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gastrochilus hoyopsis are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
